turns.text: Send payment reminders to everyone who is overdue, and tell me what our receivables look like.

{"sql": "
SELECT i.invoice_no, i.customer_no, c.name, c.email, i.issued_on, i.due_on, i.amount,
  i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no), 0) AS balance,
  julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) AS days_overdue,
  i.status
FROM erp_invoices i
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = i.customer_no
WHERE i.due_on < '2026-09-29'
  AND (i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no), 0)) > 0.01
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC
"}

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN days_overdue <= 30 THEN '1-30'
    WHEN days_overdue <= 60 THEN '31-60'
    WHEN days_overdue <= 90 THEN '61-90'
    ELSE '90+'
  END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS n_invoices, SUM(balance) AS total_balance
FROM (
  SELECT i.invoice_no,
    i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no), 0) AS balance,
    julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) AS days_overdue
  FROM erp_invoices i
  WHERE i.due_on < '2026-09-29'
) t
WHERE balance > 0.01
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
"}
